pulseOrbit.commandPolicy: Each button press or OSC trigger creates an independent visual voice and immediate enabled OSC output; oldest voice replaced only beyond 24 active voices
pulseOrbit.dataNote: Normalize upstream data before sending. Aggregated five-minute counts do not identify individual event timestamps.
pulseOrbit.idlePolicy: Bright short strokes travel at unequal speeds without scheduled bursts. Existing continuous controls and event meanings are unchanged. Perpendicular marks are created only by explicit event commands, never by continuous values or automatic crossings.

tracePolicy.birth: explicit departure, breakthrough or new-orbit command only
tracePolicy.completion: gather and fade up to four nearby marks within 2.4 seconds; target is captured at trigger time
tracePolicy.continuousMapping: none; count, length, lifetime and motion are independent of continuous controls; event origin is captured at trigger time
tracePolicy.osc: no additional OSC cues; existing event and parameter routes are unchanged

sender.bundle: OSC immediate bundle; metadata before event

status: Default OSC address reference, not an imported installation preset. Custom addresses are shown in the app OSC map.
transport: OSC over UDP; Float arguments only; MIDI output is not supported
